raiders.name: Sable
raiders.intro: A scarred raider named Sable watches the road with a sawed-off across her lap.
raiders.correct_line: pays up with a sour grin
raiders.wrong_line: snarls and swings the stock at your head

raiders.name: Rook
raiders.intro: A wiry raider named Rook circles you, a knife loose in her hand.
raiders.correct_line: tosses the caps over with a wink
raiders.wrong_line: flicks the knife up and comes at you

raiders.name: Jinx
raiders.intro: Jinx grins from the hood of a burned-out car, rifle propped on her knee.
raiders.correct_line: laughs and slides the loot across the asphalt
raiders.wrong_line: snaps the rifle up to her shoulder

raiders.name: Gristle
raiders.intro: A broad-shouldered raider called Gristle blocks the lane, chewing on a stimpak needle.
raiders.correct_line: gives up the stash with a grunt

raiders.name: Brick
raiders.intro: Brick, a raider with a face like a collapsed wall, leans on a rebar club.
raiders.correct_line: shrugs and kicks the stash over
raiders.wrong_line: hauls the club back over his shoulder

raiders.name: Cutter
raiders.intro: Cutter sharpens a machete on the tollbooth rail, watching you the whole time.
raiders.wrong_line: comes over the rail with the blade leading

sites.name: Vault 68
sites.flavor: A sealed ration hall where the numbers never balanced. Ninety-nine men, one woman, and a ledger that decided everything.
sites.lore: Vault-Tec called it a population study. The residents called it the ratio.

encounter.name: Vault 68 Atrium
encounter.flavor: The atrium is split by a ration queue that has not moved in two hundred years.

node.prompt: The Overseer's council blocks the exit. How do you get the vault to open?

sites.name: Vault 69
sites.flavor: A sealed dormitory holding ninety-nine women and one man, with a council that never let the door open.
sites.lore: A sealed dormitory experiment built around ninety-nine women and one man, with a council that never let the door open.

encounter.name: Vault 69 Atrium
encounter.flavor: The dormitory ring is quiet except for the click of a locked council door.

node.prompt: The council will not release the door. What is your way through?
